findings.title: The notes do not say if the owner's own till, card reader and distributor are supported

location.description: the three notes under the hero, starting with the note that begins "Works with your till"

findings.viewer_experience: An owner reads "Works with your till" and "Orders from your distributor" and cannot tell if their own till, card reader or distributor is supported. "Returns are tracked for you" does not say who tracks them. The trial button asks the owner to commit on trust.

current.value: No named till, card reader or distributor; no statement of who tracks returns; no comparison with how the owner works now

findings.target: The notes name the supported tills and card readers, the distributors that get reorder lists, who tracks returns, and give one comparison with how the owner works now. The maker must supply these facts.
findings.fix_direction: The maker supplies the supported tills and card readers, the distributors that get reorder lists, who tracks returns, and one comparison with how the owner works now. Then edit "Returns are tracked for you" to name who tracks them. Do not invent these facts.

closed_when.check: In the desktop, phone, tablet and widescreen images, the notes name the supported tills, card readers and distributors, say who tracks returns, and give one comparison with how the owner works now, with facts supplied by the maker.

findings.title: Notes 1 and 2 are below 45 characters per line

location.description: note 1 and note 2 of the three notes under the hero

findings.viewer_experience: At 44 and 40 characters per line the notes still read comfortably, so this is a convention point only.
findings.target: 45 or more characters per line, only if the maker wants the number met
findings.fix_direction: Change the column width only if the maker wants the number met. Widening the gap moved one note over 45 and the other under it, so the gap alone will not fix both.

closed_when.check: characters_per_line of section.facts > p:nth-of-type(1) and section.facts > p:nth-of-type(2) in the desktop and widescreen viewports is 45 or more

findings.title: Note 2 is the only three-line note, so the bottom edge of the three columns is uneven

location.description: note 2 of the three notes under the hero

findings.viewer_experience: The bottom edge of the three columns is uneven because note 2 runs one line longer than the others.
findings.target: Note 2 runs to two lines, like notes 1 and 3
findings.fix_direction: A small cut to its words would bring it to two lines, for example "One click sends your reorder list in your distributor's format."

closed_when.check: lines of section.facts > p:nth-of-type(2) in the desktop and widescreen viewports is 2
